gloss: usually; normally; on a daily basis

definitions.explanation: Refers to one's typical daily routine or habitual state.

examples.japanese: {日頃|ひごろ}からの{努力|どりょく}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
{日頃|ひごろ}お{世話|せわ}になっております。
examples.english: Thank you for your continued support.

examples.japanese: {日頃|ひごろ}の{運動|うんどう}{不足|ぶそく}がたたった。
examples.english: My usual lack of exercise caught up with me.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{日|ひ} (day) + {頃|ころ} (around, about) → around the days = daily, usually

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{日頃|ひごろ}から - from day to day, habitually
・{日頃|ひごろ}の - one's usual, everyday
・{日頃|ひごろ}お{世話|せわ}になっております - (polite) Thank you for your continued support

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{普段|ふだん} - usually, normally
・いつも - always
・{毎日|まいにち} - every day

REGISTER:
Slightly formal. Often used in business correspondence and speeches.
